question: Add a new required field AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig to the DataSourceConnection struct in Grafana's datasource API types. DataSourceConnection defines how Grafana connects to backends like Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, and Tempo. All datasource plugins constructing this struct will break.

affected_files.reason: Defines the DataSourceConnection struct (line 36). The new AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig field must be added here alongside Title, Name, APIGroup, APIVersion, and Plugin.

The asConnection() method (line 297-304) constructs DataSourceConnection{Title, APIGroup, APIVersion, Name, Plugin} from a legacy DataSource model. Must populate the new AuthConfig field. This is the central construction point used by ListConnections (line 221) which serves all datasource plugins via the DataSourceConnectionProvider interface.
legacyConnectionClientImpl.GetConnectionByUID() (line 121-130) constructs DataSourceConnection{APIGroup, APIVersion, Name, Plugin} struct literal. Must add AuthConfig field to the construction.
Multiple test cases construct DataSourceConnection struct literals (lines 85, 87, 94, 96, 159, 169-175) for assertions. All struct literals need the new AuthConfig field added.

Mock implementation of GetConnection (line 105) and ListConnections (line 110) return *v0alpha1.DataSourceConnection and *v0alpha1.DataSourceConnectionList respectively. Interface signature references the type.

REST storage adapter for Kubernetes API server managing DataSourceConnection resources via GET/LIST operations. The connectionAccess struct delegates to PluginDatasourceProvider which returns DataSource objects (not DataSourceConnection directly), but the REST layer serves DataSourceConnection resources.

References DataSourceConnectionList in OpenAPI schema definition (line 73) and constructs DataSourceConnectionQuery (line 134) for the /connections API route. The route handler calls ListConnections which returns DataSourceConnectionList containing DataSourceConnection items.

Defines PluginDatasourceProvider interface and ScopedPluginDatasourceProvider. While the interface methods return DataSource (not DataSourceConnection), the cachingDatasourceProvider implementation is the concrete provider used by all datasource plugins. The DataSourceConnection is constructed downstream from this provider's data.

answer.impact_summary: Adding AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig to DataSourceConnection breaks all struct literal constructions. The primary construction path is Service.asConnection() in pkg/services/datasources/service/datasource.go which is called by ListConnections() — the implementation of DataSourceConnectionProvider interface. This serves ALL datasource plugins (Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, etc.) through the query API routes. The legacy connection client in pkg/api/datasource/connections.go also constructs the struct directly. All test files with struct literals will also fail compilation.
